question: Can even immense material wealth compare to the value of this Kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
This sets up a comparison of value
inference: Even the wealth of an ocean filled with jewels is invoked as a measure of comparison.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a fused and unclear transmission form
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels...
